notes: The breadboard image labels rows f-j in the upper half and a-e in the lower half; catalogue banks 'b' (f-j) and 't' (a-e) were used by row letter, so the upper half is bank 'b' and the lower half is bank 't'.
LED legs are in row g of columns 9-12 (R, common anode, G, B); each 220 ohm resistor bridges the centre gap from row f to row e in columns 9, 11 and 12.
The manual text says 'common anode' with the longest pin wired to 5V; the code comment says 'Anode: GND' but the circuit image and schematic show 5V, so 5V is used.
The 5V wire lands on column 10 row f, the same strip as the LED's common leg (10b.g).
The manual says 4 wires; the schematic's resistor values are 220 ohm. No Arduino GND connection is drawn.
